## B1 — Intro station

*(label)* Epi-Logos / M5 / The Doorway · **The Six Layers**

> Every map stands outside its territory — that is what lets it refer at all. But there is one territory no map can stand outside of: consciousness itself. Any vantage you take on awareness is taken from within awareness; the one reality that cannot be doubted is that of the One doing the doubting. Descartes proved exactly this — and the West, almost immediately, looked away, building magnificent sciences of the object while the knower slipped out of every picture. The East never made that cut; its rigour went the other way, into the knowing side. Epi-Logos is built where the two rigours finally meet. The Reality mapped here is the Self of all conscious beings — so the map must, by its own logic, contain its maker, its system, and you. That is why the system appears inside its own cosmology, as its fifth subsystem: Epii. These six layers are Epii's anatomy, and each has two faces: Bimba, the original — what the layer is in the living map; Pratibimba, the reflection — how it becomes something you can use.
